audit.summary: The current later PyTorch release retains untruncated MRR under cutoff-specific names, an empty-prediction correctness fallback, and unscaled ranking logits in its SDPA path. It also retains a documented later normalization change that can reverse cross-head document rankings. These Minor release/replication concerns do not establish errors in the original JAX/TPU results.
limitations: No author program, attention kernel, model or old verifier was executed. The public PyTorch release is later than the original JAX/TPU experiments. Missing historical predictions prevent estimating metric or ranking effects on the paper’s tables. Normalization is a documented version difference whose intent and empirical merits remain unestablished.

proposition.claim:
The paper reports MRR@\(10\) and P@1.

The paper normalizes query-to-document attention over document tokens.

The SDPA and eager attention backends should return equivalent ranking logits for the same query/key tensors.

repair.content:
Apply the rank cutoff before reciprocal-rank scoring; return zero for empty predictions; preserve IDs/scores explicitly.

Use the documented document-token denominator or explicitly describe the alternate scoring variant. Historical table attribution remains unresolved.

Apply \(1/\sqrt{d_k}\) to returned logits under the same convention, then check backend parity.
